special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The achaierai has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The achaierai makes two attacks with its Talons and one attack with its Beak.

actions.name: Beak
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Defensive Cloud
reactions.desc: After taking damage the achaierai can use its reaction to release a cloud of poisonous gas in a 10-foot-radius. All creatures in the cloud take 7 (2d6) poison damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned the target is confused as if from a confusion spell. At the end of its turns, the affected target can repeat the Constitution saving throw. If it succeeds the confusion ends. Achaierai are immune to the effects of this cloud.

name: Aribeth de Tylmarande
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Infernal Tracker
special_abilities.desc: Aribeth knows the distance to and direction of any creature that has broken a pact with Mephistopheles, even if the creature and Aribeth are on different planes of existence.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Aribeth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Nightmare
special_abilities.desc: Aribeth is accompanied by a nightmare. The nightmare allows Aribeth to use it as a mount.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: Aribeth regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If Aribeth takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Aribeth's next turn. Aribeth's body is destroyed only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

special_abilities.name: Shadows
special_abilities.desc: Three shadows hide within the saddle of Aribeth's nightmare. These shadows only come out if there is a creature within 30 feet that is at 0 hit points. When that happens, a shadow emerges and attacks the creature in order to make it fail a death saving throw. It continues to do so until the creature is dead.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, Aribeth has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Aribeth makes three Void or Unholy Strike attacks.

actions.name: Void
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points from damage dealt by the sword Void dies and can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

actions.name: Unholy Strike
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Aribeth casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
1/day: dispel magic
2/day each: aid, command, magic weapon, searing smite, shield of faith

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Aribeth adds 4 to her AC against one melee attack that would hit her. To do so, Aribeth must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Baalzebul
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Baalzebul's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Fiendish Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: Baalzebul regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Baalzebul dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

special_abilities.name: Lord of Flies
special_abilities.desc: Insects don't attack Baalzebul, and he can issue orders to them.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Baalzebul fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Baalzebul has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Stench of the Slug
special_abilities.desc: A creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of Baalzebul must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature is immune to this stench for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Baalzebul uses Heart of Pestilence (if available), then makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Pungent Eruption (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Baalzebul causes refuse and caustic liquid to spill from the ground at a point he can see within 300 feet. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Targets take 36 (8d8) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Creatures that fail the save have the poisoned condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Heart of Pestilence (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Baalzebul channels pestilence into his body, sickening creatures within 50 feet that can see him. Sickened creatures must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, followed by a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. Failing the Charisma save makes a creature have the frightened condition, while failing the Constitution save makes a creature weak. While weakened, a creature deals half damage on melee attacks. Both effects last for 1 minute or until a greater restoration spell or similar is cast.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Baalzebul casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24):
At will: animate dead, darkness, detect evil and good, detect magic, dispel evil and good, hallow, hold monster, suggestion, teleport, true seeing
1/day each: symbol (pain or insanity), wish

legendary_actions.name: Pummel
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul makes a Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul uses Displace.

legendary_actions.name: Insect Gorge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul disgorges a swarm of biting flies at a point he can see within 300 feet of himself. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 21 Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The biting flies persist for 1 minute, or until Baalzebul uses this ability again. Creatures that enter the flies' area or end their turn inside it must repeat the saving throw.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Baalzebul summons an allied bone devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

name: Bebilith
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands Abyssal but only speaks telepathically to its own kind, telepathy 120 ft.

special_abilities.name: Dark Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the bebilith's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The bebilith can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down, without needing to make an ability check and ignores any movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bebilith uses Poisoned Web (if available) and then makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage plus 21 (6d6) poison damage. Any creature that drops to zero hit points because of this attack ignites, suffering 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until the creature's hit points are above zero.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Poisoned Web (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. Hit: 51 (10d8 + 6) poison damage, and the target has the restrained condition until free of the web. While restrained, the target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target may use an action to make a DC 17 Strength check and if successful they are freed from the webbing. The webbing can also be attacked and destroyed (AC 12; 10 hit points; immunity to bludgeoning, fire, poison, and psychic damage). If an attack or spell doing fire damage is used on the webbing, the webbing ignites (but is otherwise unharmed). Any creature restrained by the webbing suffers an additional 7 (2d6) fire damage at the start of each of its turn.

actions.name: Stalker's Darkness (3/Day)
actions.desc: The bebilith casts darkness.

name: Bhaal, Ravager
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Avatar of Bhaal
special_abilities.desc: When the ravager drops to 0 hit points, its form fractures. Within the next 24 hours, it will reappear in its slayer form within 2d6 miles of where the ravager form fell.

special_abilities.name: Cull the Weak
special_abilities.desc: When the ravager damages a creature with a melee attack and the target is left with 20 or fewer remaining hit points, the creature must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or be reduced to 0 hit points.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The ravager is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If the ravager fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The ravager has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The ravager's Claw, Bite, and Spines attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Spiked Hide
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of its turns, the ravager deals 16 (3d10) piercing damage to any creature grappling it or being grappled by it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ravager makes one Bite attack and then either two Claw attacks or two Spines attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d8 + 9) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 21 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Large or smaller creatures damaged by this attack are grappled (escape DC 20) and the ravager can't make another Bite attack until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Spines
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, range 60/120 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (3d6 + 7) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 19 Constitution saving throw, they are stunned until the end of their next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Spiky Carapace
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager flares its numerous spines and they elongate. Any creature within 5 feet of the ravager must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 27 (5d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Smash (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The ravager smashes downwards with great force, causing a violent implosion. Any creature within 10 feet of the ravager must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures that fail the saving throw are also pulled 5 feet towards the ravager. The noise produced by this attack can be heard up to 1 mile away.

name: Bhaal, Slayer
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Assassinate
special_abilities.desc: During its first turn, the slayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the slayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the slayer's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The slayer is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form, except for its Ravager Form ability.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If the slayer fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The slayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The slayer's claw attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The slayer makes four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

legendary_actions.name: Savage Disengage
legendary_actions.desc: The slayer disengages without provoking opportunity attacks. If it moves within 5 feet of a creature it makes a Claw attack against the creature.

legendary_actions.name: Finish (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The slayer attacks a creature that has been marked by its Prey ability. If this attack hits and the creature has less than 40 hit points remaining after the attack, the creature is reduced to 0 hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Ravager Form (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: If the slayer has killed a creature of CR/level 5 or greater that it previously marked with its Prey ability in the last minute, it can transform into its ravager form. The form lasts until dawn (minimum 1 hour).

name: Bodhi Irenicus
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Bodhi fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: Bodhi regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If Bodhi is destroyed, her body immediately appears in her resting place. She is paralyzed until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 24 hours in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point. While paralyzed in this manner, if a creature within 60 feet says her name 9 times, Bodhi is permanently destroyed.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: Bodhi deals an extra 28 (8d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Bodhi that isn't incapacitated and Bodhi doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: Bodhi can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Summoned By Name (1/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If a creature says Bodhi Irenicus's full name 9 times in a row, Bodhi hears her name and becomes aware of the creature. Bodhi knows the exact location and name of the creature that spoke her name. She can then choose, as a free action, to teleport to a location adjacent to the creature. She must choose to do this within 1 minute of hearing her name. This power works even if the creature is on a different plane of existence. 1 minute after teleporting, Bodhi teleports back to where she was located when she heard her name spoken. This occurs even if Bodhi is unwilling and even if she is in an antimagic effect.

special_abilities.name: Vampire Weaknesses
special_abilities.desc:
Bodhi Irenicus has the following flaws:
Elvish Song: Bodhi can't abide a song performed in the elvish language. A creature that can speak the elvish language can use an action to sing an elven song. If Bodhi is within 60 feet of the singer and can hear the song, she has disadvantage on attacks and saving throws.
Stake to the Heart: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Bodhi's heart while she is incapacitated in her resting place, Bodhi is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity: Bodhi takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

actions.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Bodhi makes three Unarmed Strike attacks, one of which can be a Bite attack instead.

actions.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, Bodhi can grapple a Medium-sized or smaller target (escape DC 18).

actions.name: Bite (Panther or Vampire Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Bodhi regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A Humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Bodhi's control.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: If Bodhi isn't in sunlight, she can polymorph into a Medium panther or back into her true form. While in panther form, Bodhi Irenicus can't speak, her walking speed is 40 feet, and she has a climb speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

actions.name: Charm
actions.desc: Bodhi targets one Humanoid she can see within 30 feet of her. If the target can see Bodhi, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by Bodhi. The charmed target regards Bodhi as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Bodhi's control, it takes Bodhi's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can. Each time Bodhi or her allies do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Bodhi is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Unarmed Strike
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi makes one Unarmed Strike.

legendary_actions.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Bodhi makes one Bite attack.

special_abilities.name: Bolts of Undead Slaying
special_abilities.desc: Borivik has a half-dozen bolts of undead slaying. If he strikes an Undead creature with one of these magic bolts, it must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 33 (6d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Borivik makes two Shortsword attacks or two Heavy Crossbow attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Borivik casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: ensnaring strike, speak with animals
2/day each: cordon of arrows, daylight, lesser restoration, nondetection

reactions.name: Enduring Response
reactions.desc: When Borivik takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, he gains immunity to that damage type until the start of his next turn. Also, the first time he hits with a Shortsword attack on his next turn, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) of the triggering damage type.

name: Cornelius Watson
languages: Celestial, Common, Dwarvish, Gnomish, Halfling, Infernal

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Doc Watson has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Portent (Recharge 6)
special_abilities.desc: When Doc Watson or a creature he can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, Doc Watson can roll a d20 and choose to use this roll in place of the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check. This trait recharges after using the Spellcasting action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Doc Watson makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.desc: ms,rs +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) lightning damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Doc Watson casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At will: detect magic, identify, mage armor, Rary's telepathic bond
2/day each: clairvoyance, locate object, scrying
1/day each: foresight, true seeing

name: Cryonax
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Cold Aura
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of Cryonax's turns, each creature within 10 feet of him takes 21 (6d6) cold damage. A creature also takes 21 (6d6) cold damage if they touch or hit Cryonax. Nonmagical weapons that hit Cryonax are frozen immediately after dealing damage to Cryonax. If used again and they hit any creature, the weapon shatters. The freezing effect disappears after an hour.

special_abilities.name: Empowered Attacks
special_abilities.desc: Cryonax's Slam attacks are treated as magical for the purpose of bypassing resistance and immunity to nonmagical weapons.

special_abilities.name: Ice Walker
special_abilities.desc: No ability checks are required when Cryonax walks or climbs across icy surfaces and difficult snow or ice terrain does not cost him extra movement.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Cryonax fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Cryonax has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Cryonax makes two Slam attacks with his tentacles or two Ice Spear attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (3d12 + 8) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 20). Cryonax can grapple up to two targets but any tentacle that is grappling can't be used to make a Slam or Ice Spear attack.

actions.name: Ice Spear
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 36 (6d10 + 3) cold damage.

actions.name: Summon Frost Horde (1/Day)
actions.desc: Cryonax summons two young white dragons or a frost giant with two yetis. The summoning costs Cryonax 50 hit points. The summoned creatures have maximum hit points and appear within 100 feet of Cryonax.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Cryonax casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: ice storm, sleet storm, wall of ice
2/day each: cone of cold, otiluke's freezing sphere (45 (13d6) damage)

legendary_actions.name: Smash
legendary_actions.desc: Cryonax slams a grappled target against the ground, dealing 13 (3d8) bludgeoning damage to it.

legendary_actions.name: Tentacle Freeze
legendary_actions.desc: Cryonax's tentacle freezes a grappled target. If the target fails a DC 22 Constitution saving throw they are paralyzed and Cryonax releases them from its tentacle. They remain frozen indefinitely but can attempt the Constitution saving throw at the end of each of their turns. Success means they are no longer frozen.

legendary_actions.name: Ice Shroud (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: With a gesture Cryonax targets a frozen creature (see Tentacle Freeze) that is within 30 feet of him. The target is encased instantly in a hard shell of crushing ice. The target receives no saving throw and takes 22 (5d8) cold damage immediately and at the start of each of their turns. The target is considered stunned but is partly protected by the shroud and resistant to all damage. The shroud disappears if Cryonax removes it, Cryonax dies, the shroud takes 100 hit points of damage or another character uses their action and succeeds on a DC 22 Strength check to remove the trapped ally.

special_abilities.name: Draconic Transformation
special_abilities.desc: When Dagryn drops to 0 hit points, instead of falling unconscious, he transforms into his dragon form. He immediately gains all the statistics of an adult black dragon with the exception that his size is Medium, and has the stunned condition. At the start of his next turn, he grows to Large size, but remains stunned. At the start of his subsequent turn, Dagryn grows to Huge size and is no longer stunned. Dagryn remains in his dragon form for 24 hours whereupon he reverts to this stat block.

special_abilities.name: Dwarven Resilience
special_abilities.desc: Dagryn has advantage on saving throws against poison, spells, and illusions, as well as to resist being charmed or paralyzed.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Eruption
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Dagryn casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: alter self, disguise self, levitate, major image, vicious mockery
2/day each: bane, fear, hold monster, misty step
1/day each: dimension door, seeming

name: Darien
languages: Aquan, Auran, Common, Elvish, Giant, telepathy 30 ft.

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Darien can see normally in darkness, both magical and nonmagical, to a distance of 120 feet

special_abilities.name: Eldritch Mind
special_abilities.desc: Darien has advantage on Constitution saving throws that she makes to maintain concentration on a spell.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Darien makes two War Pick attacks.

actions.name: War Pick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft, one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 4 necrotic damage.

actions.name: Eldritch Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 300 ft., three targets. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Create Thrall
actions.desc: Darien touches an incapacitated Humanoid. That creature is then charmed by her until a remove curse spell is cast on it, the charmed condition is removed from it, or she uses this feature again. Darien can communicate telepathically with the charmed creature as long as the two of them are on the same plane of existence.

actions.name: Summon War Pick
actions.desc: Darien creates a magical war pick in her empty hand. The war pick counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage. The war pick has a +1 bonus to attack and damage (already factored into Darien's attacks).

actions.name: Innate Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Darien casts one of the following spells, requiring no material component and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: alter self, blade ward, chill touch, disguise self, false life, invisibility, mage armor (self only), silent image
2/day each: armor of Agathys, cone of cold, darkness, fear, hallucinatory terrain, hold person, hypnotic pattern, major image, mirror image, mislead, sleet storm
1/day each: dream, feeblemind, mass suggestion, project image

reactions.name: Shield of Cryonax (1/Day)
reactions.desc: When Darien takes damage, she can entomb herself in ice, which melts away at the end of her next turn. She gains 150 temporary hit points, which take as much of the triggering damage as possible. Immediately after she takes the damage, she gains vulnerability to fire damage, her speed is reduced to 0, and she is incapacitated. These effects, including any remaining temporary hit points, all end when the ice melts.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The deep spider can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Web Sense
special_abilities.desc: While in contact with a web, the deep spider knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The deep spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The deep spider makes one Bite attack and two Foreleg attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the target is stable but poisoned for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and has the paralyzed condition while poisoned in this way.

actions.name: Foreleg
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (4d6 + 5) slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Ambusher
special_abilities.desc: The dread doppelganger has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

special_abilities.name: Shapechanger
special_abilities.desc: The dread doppelganger can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium Humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

special_abilities.name: Surprise Attack
special_abilities.desc: If the dread doppelganger surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 17 (5d6) damage from the attack.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dread doppelganger makes three Slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6).

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.desc: The dread doppelganger magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 ft. of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, the dread doppelganger can continue reading its thoughts, as long as the dread doppelganger's Concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, the doppelganger has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The dread doppelganger casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
2/day: phantasmal killer
1/day each: mirror image, mislead

name: Edwin Odesseiron

armor.name: with staff of power and mage armor

languages: Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Common, Ignan, Infernal, Terran, Thayan

special_abilities.name: Contingency
special_abilities.desc: If Edwin has the incapacitated, paralyzed, or stunned condition, a contingency spell triggers, casting dispel magic at 6th level, targeting Edwin. He also has a body created by the clone spell stored in a cavern one mile beneath the city of Baldur's Gate.

special_abilities.name: Simulacrum
special_abilities.desc: Edwin is always accompanied by a simulacrum of himself. The copy is identical to him in all respects except that it has 58 hit points, does not have the staff of power and can only cast the 'at will' spells available in Edwin's Spellcasting feature.

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Edwin wields a staff of power. While held the staff grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and a +2 bonus to armor class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls (all factored into Edwin's statistics).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Edwin makes a Staff of Power attack or uses Spellcasting or Staff Spellcasting. He then makes two Elemental Blast attacks.

actions.name: Staff of Power
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands. Edwin can expend one of the staff's charges to deal an extra 14 (4d6) force damage on a hit.

actions.name: Elemental Blast
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: +12 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 38 (6d10 + 5) acid, cold, lightning, or fire damage.

actions.name: Edwin's Choking Cloud (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Edwin creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of poisonous fog centered on a point within 120 feet. The cloud spreads around corners but lasts only until the start of Edwin's next turn. When a creature enters the cloud's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. The creature takes 45 (10d8) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Edwin casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: mage armor, mirror image, shield, unseen servant
2/day each: contingency, counterspell, dispel magic, fireball, simulacrum, scrying
1/day each: clone, maze, meteor swarm, teleport

actions.name: Staff Spellcasting
actions.desc: While holding the staff of power, Edwin casts one of the following spells (spell save DC 18, +12 to hit with spell attacks). These spells require charges; the staff has 20 charges, and it regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. 1 charge each: magic missile, ray of enfeeblement 2 charges: levitate 5 charges each: cone of cold, fireball (5th level), hold monster, lightning bolt (5th level), wall of force 6 charges: globe of invulnerability

reactions.name: Edwin's Evasive Footwork
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Edwin teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that he can see.

name: Eo Ashmajiir
languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal, Undercommon

special_abilities.name: Lightning Affinity
special_abilities.desc: When Eo uses Spellcasting to cast a spell that deals lightning damage, that spell deals an additional 5 damage. When Eo casts a spell that deals a type of damage from the following list, she can change that damage type to lightning: acid, cold, fire, poison, thunder.

actions.name: Twinned Orbs
actions.desc: ms,rs +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft., two targets. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder damage (Eo's choice).

actions.name: Twinned Spell
actions.desc: Eo uses Spellcasting to cast banishment, dominate person, finger of death, or power word stun. This spell targets a second creature in range.

actions.name: Discharge (1/Day)
actions.desc: Eo emits a thin green ray at a creature within 60 feet. The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save the target takes 89 (14d6 + 40) force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, it is disintegrated. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying, except magic items, are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. The creature can be restored to life only by means of a true resurrection or a wish spell.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Eo casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: detect magic, detect thoughts, light, mage hand, magic missile, prestidigitation, shield, shocking grasp
2/day each: banishment, counterspell, dominate person, fireball, lightning bolt, mirror image, misty step
1/day each: chain lightning, finger of death, power word stun, teleport, wish*
* Eo uses wish to ensure she has a simulacrum of herself at all times.

reactions.name: Shocking Rebuke
reactions.desc: As a reaction to taking damage, Eo surrounds her attacker with a coil of lightning. The target must make a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. It takes 16 (2d10 + 5) lightning damage on a failed save, half as much damage on a successful one.

special_abilities.name: Staff of the Woodlands
special_abilities.desc:
This staff can be wielded as a magic quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it and grants Faldorn a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls (already factored into Faldorn's attacks). The staff has 10 charges. It regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges each dawn. Faldorn can use an action to expend 1 or more of the staff's charges to cast one of the following spells from it, with a spell save DC of 14:
0 charges: pass without trace
1 charge each: animal friendship, speak with animals
2 charges each: barkskin, locate animals or plants
3 charges: speak with plants
5 charges: awaken
6 charges: wall of thorns

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Faldorn makes two Staff of the Woodlands attacks and uses Spellcasting. Or she uses Spellcasting and then Change Shape if available.

actions.name: Staff of the Woodlands
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, or 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Shadowlight (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: A beam of dim light emerges from Faldorn in a 5-foot-wide, 300-foot-long line. Each creature in the line must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 27 (6d8) radiant damage and is blinded until Faldorn's next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

actions.name: Change Shape (2/Day)
actions.desc: Faldorn magically polymorphs into a Beast or Elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Faldorn reverts to her true form if she dies or falls unconscious. She can revert to her true form using a bonus action on her turn. While in a new form, Faldorn retains her game statistics and ability to speak, but her AC, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and she gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that she lacks. She can cast her spells with verbal or somatic components in her new form. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Faldorn casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: druidcraft, poison spray, shillelagh
2/day each: entangle, locate creature, speak with animals, stoneskin, tree stride, water breathing
1/day each: foresight, heal

name: Farastu Stalker
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Adhesive Slime
special_abilities.desc: The farastu secretes a thick, tar-like slime and it can choose to use this slime to secure enemies that it has grappled or to make weapons become attached to it. It is able to end the adhesion with a bonus action, causing all items and creatures secured to it to be released. The adhesion also ends after the farastu dies.

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the farastu's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The farastu has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The farastu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The farastu's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn, the farastu can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The farastu makes one Bite attack and two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage. The target is held fast by the farastu's adhesive slime (grappled condition, escape DC 15) if the farastu isn't already grappling a creature.

reactions.name: Adhesive Hide
reactions.desc: After taking damage from a melee weapon, the farastu uses its reaction to attach the weapon to its hide. The attacker must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the weapon becomes attached to the farastu's adhesive hide until the farastu dies or releases the weapon. A creature can also use an action to make a DC 15 Strength check, prying the weapon free from the farastu, if successful.

special_abilities.name: Battle Smith
special_abilities.desc: Flimp uses his Intelligence modifier for attack and damage rolls with his weapons.

special_abilities.name: Gnome Cunning
special_abilities.desc: Flimp has advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws against magic.

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Flimp wears a cloak of the manta ray, a cloak of protection, +2 plate armor, and winged boots. Flimp wields a +2 warhammer. These items vanish 4 days after Flimp dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Flimp makes two Magic Warhammer attacks.

actions.name: Magic Warhammer
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Hurl Acid (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Flimp hurls a vial of acid at a location within 60 feet. Every creature within 10 feet of the target location must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Summon Steel Defender (1/Day)
actions.desc: Flimp summons a metallic panther to aid him in combat. The panther has 24 hit points and is immune to poison damage and the poison and charmed conditions.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Flimp casts one of the following spells using Intelligence as his spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: guidance, light
2/day each: aid, blur, cure wounds, shield
1/day each: blink, elemental weapon, fire shield

reactions.name: Flash of Genius
reactions.desc: When Flimp or another creature he can see within 30 feet of him makes an ability check or a saving throw, Flimp can use his reaction to add +4 to the roll.

special_abilities.name: Light Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in bright light, gibberlings have disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn, the gibberling can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Swarm
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the grappled condition (escape DC 10). All gibberlings within 5 feet of the target can use a reaction to make a Dagger attack with advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Burrow
actions.desc: The gibberling burrows into the dirt, giving itself the prone condition. It has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while it is prone.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The hamadryad has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
special_abilities.desc: The hamadryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

special_abilities.name: Tree Stride
special_abilities.desc: Once on her turn, the hamadryad can use 10 feet of her movement to step magically into one living tree within her reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large in size or bigger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hamadryad makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The hamadryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
2/day: entangle
1/day each: barkskin, grasping vine, pass without trace

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: If Imoen is subjected to an effect that allows her to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Imoen instead takes no damage if she succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if she fails.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: Imoen deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Imoen that isn't incapacitated and Imoen doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: Imoen can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

special_abilities.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
special_abilities.desc: While in sunlight, Imoen has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Imoen makes two Shortsword attacks and one Hand Crossbow attack.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/210 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: Jaheira has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Jaheira to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jaheira makes three Quarterstaff attacks.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) thunder damage.

actions.name: Cleansing Plague (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Jaheira targets a creature she can see within 60 feet and causes a swarm of flying insects to cover the creature. The creature must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If the target fails their saving throw they are also blinded until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Jaheira casts ones of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: barkskin, druidcraft, poison spray, produce flame, shillelagh
2/day each: animal messenger, commune with nature (as an action), entangle, speak with animals
1/day each: heal, heroes' feast, stoneskin

name: Jon Irenicus
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Elvish, Infernal, Sylvan

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Jon Irenicus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If he has a phylactery and he is destroyed, Jon Irenicus gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Jon Irenicus carries a rod of lordly might. He can use a bonus action to switch it between its Mace and Flame Tongue attacks.

special_abilities.name: Turn Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Jon Irenicus has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns Undead.

actions.name: Multiattack (only useable with Transformation)
actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes two Flame Tongue attacks or two Mace attacks. Each attack is made with advantage and does an additional 13 (2d12) force damage if it hits.

actions.name: Flame Tongue (Rod of Lordly Might)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage and 7 (2d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Mace (Rod of Lordly Might)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Breath of Death (1/Day)
actions.desc: Jon Irenicus emits a 90-foot cone of necrotic energy. Each creature in the effects area must make a DC 21 saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Jon Irenicus casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: Melf's acid arrow, detect magic, detect thoughts, invisibility, magic missile, mage hand, mirror image, prestidigitation, ray of frost, shield
2/day each: animate dead, dimension door, dispel magic, fireball, scrying
1/day each: disintegrate, dominate monster, finger of death, power word kill, power word stun, time stop

legendary_actions.name: Drain Life (1/Day)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes a drain life attack with his rod of lordly might. If he hits a creature with his rod, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes an extra 14 (4d6) necrotic damage, and Jon regains a number of hit points equal to half that necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Paralyze (1/Day)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus makes a paralyze attack with his rod of lordly might. If he hits a creature with his rod, the creature must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Transformation (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Jon Irenicus becomes endowed with endurance and martial prowess for 1 minute or until he ends this effect by using a bonus action. While transformed, he gains 50 temporary hit points, proficiency in Strength and Constitution saving throw, adds his Multiattack feature, and loses his Draining Counterspell reaction and Spellcasting action.

reactions.name: Draining Counterspell
reactions.desc: Jon Irenicus interrupts a creature he can see that is casting a spell. If the spell is 3rd level or lower, it fails and has no effect. If the spell is 4th level or higher, Jon Irenicus makes an Intelligence check (DC 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage if the spell fails.

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Kagain wields a +3 greataxe. While Kagain is attuned to this weapon, his hit point maximum increases to 178. Whenever a hostile creature damages Kagain while the axe is in his possession, he must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. He can choose to fail this saving throw. While berserk, Kagain gains advantage on all melee attacks and attacks made against him are made with advantage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kagain makes three attacks with his Berserking Greataxe.

actions.name: Berserking Greataxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d12 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Weapon Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack.

legendary_actions.name: Berserk Whirlwind (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Kagain makes a Berserking Greataxe attack against every creature within 5 feet of him.

name: Kelubar Consul
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the kelubar's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Freedom of Movement
special_abilities.desc: The kelubar is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical affects don't reduce its speed or cause it to be paralyzed or restrained. If the kelubar spends 5 feet of movement is automatically escapes from nonmagical restraints or a creature that has it grappled. It is also able to move underwater with no movement or attack penalties.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The kelubar has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The kelubar has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The kelubar's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of its turn, the kelubar can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: The kelubar deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 ft. of an ally of the kelubar that isn't incapacitated and the kelubar doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Stench
special_abilities.desc: Any creature that is not a demodand and starts its turn within 30 feet of the kelubar must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or or have the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the stench of this kelubar for 1 hour.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kelubar makes one Bite attack and three Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The kelubar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: clairvoyance, detect magic, fear, invisibility (self only), spider climb, tongues
2/day each: dispel magic, fog cloud

reactions.name: Impossible Dodge
reactions.desc: When an attacker that the kelubar can see hits it with an attack, the kelubar can use its reaction to halve the attack's damage.

special_abilities.name: Fey Ancestry
special_abilities.desc: Kivan has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Kivan to sleep.

special_abilities.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
special_abilities.desc: Kivan has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kivan makes three Longsword attacks or three Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Volley (2/Day)
actions.desc: Kivan makes a Longbow attack against any number of creatures he can see within 150 feet. He must make a separate attack roll with advantage for each target.

name: Lothar
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Mimicry
special_abilities.desc: Lothar can mimic simple sounds he has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Lothar makes three Greataxe attacks.

actions.name: Greataxe (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, 14 (1d12 + 8) while in a rage.

actions.name: Beak (Raven or Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage in raven form, or 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage in hybrid form. If the target is Humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with wereraven lycanthropy.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Lothar can use his action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid, or into a Small raven, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. Lothar reverts to his true form if he dies.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Lothar casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: blade ward, eldritch blast, message
1/day each: bane, charm person, daylight, faerie fire, fear, misty step, plane shift

name: Mephistopheles
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede Mephistopheles' darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Fiendish Regeneration
special_abilities.desc: Mephistopheles regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes radiant damage this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Mephistopheles only dies if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and is unable to regenerate.

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: Mephistopheles doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when he flies out of an enemy's reach.

special_abilities.name: Hellfire Mastery
special_abilities.desc: Fire damage that Mephistopheles inflicts ignores resistances and immunities. Mephistopheles is immune to this effect.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Mephistopheles fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Mephistopheles has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Mephistopheles makes three Ranseur attacks. He can replace one of the attacks with Hellfire Lash (if available).

actions.name: Ranseur, +3
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) piercing plus 18 (4d8) fire or cold damage (Mephistopheles' choice).

actions.name: Hellfire Implosion (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: A bright streak of Hellfire appears at a point that Mephistopheles can see within 150 feet of him. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 31 (9d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Hellfire Lash (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Mephistopheles unleashes a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide lash of Hellfire that ignites a 5-foot-radius sphere around where it strikes. Any targets in the area of effect must make a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Mephistopheles casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 26):
At will: darkness, detect evil and good, detect magic, dispel magic, geas (duration 1 year), greater restoration, hallow, hold monster, locate creature, locate object, major image, resurrection, scrying, suggestion, wall of fire
1/day each: meteor swarm, symbol, wish

legendary_actions.name: Hellfire Wings
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles uses his wings to generate a burst of heat. Each creature within 10 feet of him must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 9 (2d8) bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) fire damage. Creatures that failed the save also have the prone condition.

legendary_actions.name: Hellfire Storm (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles creates a rain of Hellfire at a point he can see within 150 feet. Each creature within a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 24 Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 38 (7d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Call Underling (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Mephistopheles summons an allied horned devil in an unoccupied space that he can see.

special_abilities.name: Boo, The Miniature Giant Space Hamster
special_abilities.desc: Boo is Minsc's animal companion. Boo is a miniature giant space hamster and has the statistics of a rat.

special_abilities.name: Favored Enemy
special_abilities.desc: Minsc's favored enemy is evil. When he hits an evil creature with a melee attack he deals an additional 7 (2d6) slashing damage.

special_abilities.name: Reckless
special_abilities.desc: At the start of his turn, Minsc may choose to gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against him have advantage until the start of his next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Minsc makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Run, Boo, Run
reactions.desc: If Boo takes damage, Minsc can choose to take the damage instead.

special_abilities.name: Assassinate
special_abilities.desc: During his first turn, Montaron has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit Montaron scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

special_abilities.name: Evasion
special_abilities.desc: If Montaron is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, Montaron instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

special_abilities.name: Nimbleness
special_abilities.desc: Montaron can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than his.

special_abilities.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
special_abilities.desc: Montaron deals an extra 21 (6d6) damage when he hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Montaron that isn't incapacitated and Montaron doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Montaron possesses a bag of holding. He keeps the demilich, Xzar, in the bag. He also possesses a portable hole, which he uses to aid in robberies. As a bonus action, Montaron can place his portable hole in his bag of holding. This instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. Montaron and any creature within 10 feet of him is sucked through the gate to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Montaron makes three Shortsword attacks and uses the ability Unleash the Demilich if available.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 24 (7d6) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Unleash the Demilich (1/Day)
actions.desc: Montaron reaches inside his bag of holding and releases Xzar. Xzar is a demilich and appears within 5 feet of Montaron. Xzar rolls for his own initiative. Xzar can't use lair actions or legendary actions. He has a CR of 14.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Corona of Beauty
actions.desc: Naes activates an aura of sunlight that lasts for 1 minute or until he dismisses it using an action. He emits bright light in a 60-foot-radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that. His enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against any spell that deals fire or radiant damage.

actions.name: Radiant Beauty of Sune (Recharge 4-6)
actions.desc: Naes dispels any magical darkness within 30 feet of him. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of Naes that does not have Cover must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 60 radiant damage on a failed saving throw, half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the saving throw has the blinded condition for 1 minute.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Naes casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: lesser restoration, light, sanctuary
2/day each: antilife shell, blade barrier
1/day each: divine word, mass heal

reactions.name: Hard to Kill (1/Day)
reactions.desc: If Naes would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, or is subjected to an effect that would kill him instantaneously without doing damage, Naes instead drops to 1 hit point.

special_abilities.name: Potion Mishap
special_abilities.desc:
When Nauk uses the Imbibe Potion action more than once in an hour, roll 1d4 for what happens:
1. The potion works normally.
2. The potion works normally. In addition, Nauk turns invisible for 1 minute or until Nauk attacks or casts a spell.
3. The potion has no effect.
4. Instead of the normal effect, the potion causes fire to explode out of Nauk's mouth in a 15 foot cone. Nauk and any creature in the cone take 21 (6d6) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: Relentless
special_abilities.desc: When Nauk is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, he can drop to 1 hit point instead. He can't use this feature again for 24 hours

special_abilities.name: Special Items
special_abilities.desc: Nauk wears adamantine plate armor. He wields a +1 maul and a +1 heavy crossbow which is already factored into his stats. He has 2 potions of resistance (cold), 2 potions of resistance (fire), 2 potions of resistance (lightning). He has 2 potions of heroism and 4 potions of superior healing.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Nauk makes three Magic Maul attacks. Nauk may substitute one of those attacks for the Imbibe Potion action.

actions.name: Magic Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, ranged 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Imbibe Potion
actions.desc:
Nauk drinks a potion from the following list:
Potion of heroism: Nauk gains 10 temporary hit points for 1 hour. For the same duration, Nauk is under the effect of the bless spell (no concentration required).
Potion of resistance: Nauk gains resistance from one damage type for 1 hour. Nauk chooses from one of these damage types: cold, fire, lightning.
Potion of superior healing: Nauk regains 28 hit points.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Nauk adds 4 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit him. To do so, Nauk must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

name: Pazuzu
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Aura of Servile Avians
special_abilities.desc: Any evil creature with a natural fly speed and a CR of 20 or less must make a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw if they attempt to attack Pazuzu. A failed save means their action is wasted and the attack fails. On a successful saving throw the target is immune to this effect in the future.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Pazuzu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Pazuzu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Pazuzu's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Pazuzu makes two Greatsword or Talon attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Talon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapons (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: Pazuzu exhales poisonous acid in a 100-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Every creature hit by the acid must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this breath weapon melts and is disintegrated.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Pazuzu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 24):
At will: astral projection, blight, charm person, detect evil and good, dispel magic, hallow, insect plague, telekinesis, teleport, wind walk
1/day: wish
2/day each: dominate person, hypnotic pattern, plane shift (only itself and willing creatures)

legendary_actions.name: Disarm
legendary_actions.desc: Pazuzu attempts to knock a weapon out of a target's hand. He makes a Greatsword attack and if it hits, the target does not take damage but instead must make a DC 22 Strength saving throw. If the target fails the saving throw, the targeted weapon flies 10 feet away in a random direction.

legendary_actions.name: Lethal Leap
legendary_actions.desc: Pazuzu attacks once with his Greatsword or Talon and then may fly up to 60 feet away. Pazuzu's movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Pelyious Avhoste
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage from nonmagical weapons that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: Pelyious can hold his breath for 15 minutes.

actions.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
actions.desc: In Humanoid form, Pelyious makes two Scimitar attacks or two Hand Crossbow attacks. In hybrid form, he can substitute one Scimitar attack for a Bite attack.

actions.name: Scimitar (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form)
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Bite (Hybrid Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16) and until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and Pelyious can't Bite another target.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: Pelyious polymorphs into a crocodile-humanoid hybrid, or back into his true form, which is Humanoid. His statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Pelyious casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks):
At will: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
2/day each: detect magic, mage armor, shield, suggestion
1/day each: cone of cold, counterspell, fly, greater invisibility

name: Phaerimm
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Arcane Sight
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm discerns the location of all magical auras within sight and knows which creatures within 60 feet are spellcasters.

special_abilities.name: Extended Concentration
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm can concentrate on two different spells at the same time. If concentration is broken, then both spells fade immediately.

special_abilities.name: Immutable Form
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The phaerimm has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes four Claw attacks and then makes a Bite or Stinger attack. Alternatively, it uses Spellcasting and then makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) piercing damage. If the target fails a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, they have the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. The phaerimm's poison forces the paralyzed target to float 5 feet above the ground. The target may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of it's turns.

actions.name: Implant
actions.desc: The phaerimm makes a Stinger attack against a paralyzed target. If the stinger hits, an egg is implanted in the target. This egg can only be removed by spells that cure disease, such as lesser restoration. If the egg is not removed within 90 days, the larva emerges, and the host is killed. A phaerimm has a single egg so may only use this ability once.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The phaerimm casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):
At will: mage hand, minor illusion, telekinesis
2/day each: crown of madness, detect thoughts, dominate person, fear, fireball, phantasmal force, magic missile, shield
1/day each: chain lightning, confusion, dominate monster, greater invisibility, hold monster, mass suggestion, prismatic spray, reverse gravity

special_abilities.name: Special Equipment
special_abilities.desc: Saemon wears a quiver of Ehlonna (holding 40 handaxes).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Saemon makes three Handaxe attacks.

actions.name: Handaxe
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Saemon casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation
2/day each: counterspell, detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, misty step, suggestion
1/day each: fly, greater invisibility, ice storm

legendary_actions.name: Hurl
legendary_actions.desc: Saemon makes a ranged Handaxe attack.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Saemon uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Animate Objects (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Saemon casts animate objects, targeting up to 10 handaxes he has thrown at enemies. If there are not 10 handaxes available, then he provides the remaining handaxes from his quiver of Ehlonna. Handaxes are Tiny objects.

reactions.name: Arcane Shield
reactions.desc: Saemon conjures a swirling yellow barrier and until the start of his next turn he adds +5 to his AC, including against the triggering attack, and he takes no damage from magic missile.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
