special_abilities.desc: Sarevok has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Rejuvenation
special_abilities.desc: If Sarevok is killed he gains a new body in 24 hours, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears on the altar of the temple of Bhaal beneath Baldur's Gate. This ability ceases to function if a cleric of good alignment casts Hallow on the altar in the temple of Bhaal.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Sarevok makes two Longsword attacks. He may replace one of the attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8 + 5) slashing damage or 10 (1d10 + 5) if wielded in two hands. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed by Bhaal. The cursed target can't regain hit points. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Assassin's Strike
actions.desc: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack. If he hits the target and has advantage on the attack roll, then he deals an additional 21 (6d6) poison damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have the poisoned condition for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Sarevok casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: resistance, sacred flame, thaumaturgy
1/day each: animate dead, command, contagion, dispel magic, divination, harm, hold person, silence

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok makes a Longsword attack.

legendary_actions.name: Unholy Flame
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok casts sacred flame.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Bhaal's Hate (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Sarevok unleashes Bhaal's power. Creatures within 30 feet of Sarevok, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Sarevok's next turn.

name: Shator Warden
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

special_abilities.name: Devil's Sight
special_abilities.desc: Magical darkness doesn't impede the shator's darkvision.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The shator has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The shator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The shator's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The shator makes one Bite attack or one Poisonous Spit attack (if available) and then makes two Claws attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d8 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Poisonous Spit (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: The shator exhales poisonous spit in a 20-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (5d8) acid damage on a failed save and having the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The shator casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: clairvoyance, detect magic, fear, invisibility (self only), spider climb, tongues
2/day each: cloudkill, dispel magic, plane shift, Tasha's hideous laughter

reactions.name: Poisonous Slime
reactions.desc: When hit with a melee attack, the shator expels a toxic slime. The attacker must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or have the paralyzed condition for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

special_abilities.name: Amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The sirene can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The sirene has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The sirene makes two Dagger attacks or two Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) cold damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Sirene's Song (2/Day)
actions.desc: The sirene casts suggestion with a range of 1 mile that affects all creatures of the sirene's choosing in range. Each target has disadvantage on the saving throw.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The sirene casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
1/day each: crown of madness, fog cloud, invisibility

name: Skeleton Lord
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: all the languages it knew in life

special_abilities.name: Fear Aura
special_abilities.desc: Any creature hostile to the skeleton lord that starts its turn within 20 feet of the skeleton lord must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, unless the skeleton lord is incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature has the frightened condition until the start of its next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, then the creature is immune to the skeleton lord's Fear Aura for the next 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The skeleton lord has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The skeleton lord's weapon attacks are magical and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton lord makes three Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

name: Skeleton Warrior
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: all the languages it knew in life

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The skeleton warrior has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: The skeleton warrior's weapon attacks are magical and gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls (included in the attack).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The skeleton warrior makes two Greatsword attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

name: Ssendam, Lord of Madness
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks

special_abilities.name: Aura of Madness
special_abilities.desc: Any creature (other than Undead or Constructs) that ends its turn within 10 feet of Ssendam must succeed on a DC 20 Charisma saving throw or be inflicted with a random short-term madness. If a creature succeeds against any madness ability of Ssendam's, they are immune to Ssendam's madness for 1 hour.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: If Ssendam fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: Ssendam has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: Magic Weapons
special_abilities.desc: Ssendam's weapon attacks are magical.

special_abilities.name: Regeneration (Golden Amoeba Form Only)
special_abilities.desc: Ssendam regains 40 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ssendam makes three attacks: one with her Touch of Madness and two with her Chaos Staff.

actions.name: Touch of Madness
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) slashing damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. A target that fails a DC 20 Charisma saving throw is inflicted with a random short-term madness. If it is already mad, the existing madness is replaced with a random long-term madness.

actions.name: Chaos Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or have the stunned condition for 1 minute.
